info.name: Expense Splitter API
info.description:
Backend API for the Expense Splitter app. Every request except /health and /auth/* requires a JWT: run Register or Login first (Auth folder) and its Test script will copy the returned accessToken into the `accessToken` collection variable automatically, which the rest of the collection sends as `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. Auth is per-user now, not a shared secret -- group-scoped endpoints (Groups get/update/delete, all Expenses/Payments/Balances routes) additionally 403 if the caller isn't a member of that group.

Every endpoint below has saved example responses for its success case and every error case it can actually produce (400/401/403/404/409), generated from the real service code, not guessed. Error responses always follow `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string } }`, where `code` is one of NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, CONFLICT, or ERROR/INTERNAL_ERROR as a fallback.

Set `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:3000` for local dev or your deployed Render URL. `groupId`/`userId`/`expenseId`/`paymentId` default to IDs from the seed script (prisma/seed.ts) -- swap them for real IDs once you've created your own data.

variable.description: Set automatically by the Test script on Auth > Register or Auth > Login
Copy from the invite link/log after Invitations > Create -- never returned in a response body

item.name: Health
item.description: Uptime check. Public -- no auth required.

request.description: Always public. Useful as an uptime pinger target since Render's free tier spins the service down after idling.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, and changing your own password. Register/Login are public and return `{ user, accessToken }` -- a 7-day-lived JWT you send as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every other request. Run either request here first: both have a saved Test script that copies the returned accessToken into the `accessToken` collection variable automatically.

request.description: Public. Creates a user and a passwordHash for them, then returns the same shape as Login -- a public user plus a ready-to-use accessToken. `inviteToken` is optional -- when present (taken from the `?invite=` query param on the registration link emailed by Invitations > Create), registration atomically also joins the invited group and marks the invitation accepted. Saved as a Test script on this request to auto-populate the `accessToken` collection variable.

response.name: 400 Validation Error - malformed fields
409 Conflict - email already in use
201 Created - registering through a group invitation
400 Bad Request - email does not match the invitation
409 Conflict - invitation is expired, revoked, or already accepted

request.description: Public. Also returns the accessToken needed for every other request in this collection -- run this (or Register) first. Saved as a Test script on this request to auto-populate the `accessToken` collection variable.

response.name: 401 Unauthorized - wrong password or unknown email

request.description: Changes the caller's own password. Requires currentPassword even though the request is already authenticated via JWT -- a leaked/stolen token alone shouldn't be enough to lock the real account owner out.

response.name: 400 Validation Error - new password too short

item.name: Users
item.description: There is no way to manually create a user record or list every registered user -- every account comes from Auth > Register (directly or via an accepted invitation). Use Lookup to find a specific registered user by exact email/phone, or My friends to list users you share a group with. PATCH/DELETE only work on your own account (self-ownership enforced, 403 otherwise).

item.name: Lookup user by email or phone

request.description: Exact match only -- used by the frontend when a searched email/phone isn't already in the caller's friend list, to decide between "add directly" (found) and "invite by email" (not found).

response.name: 400 Bad Request - both email and phone provided
404 Not Found - no registered user matches

request.description: Derived, not stored: every user the caller has ever shared a group with (bidirectional, deduplicated, survives being removed from the group later).

Resolves a group's memberIds (or an expense's split userIds) to display-ready user records in one call, since there's no unfiltered GET /users to fetch everyone and filter client-side anymore. IDs are opaque UUIDs, so this isn't an enumeration risk -- you can only look up IDs you already have from data you were authorized to see.

response.name: 200 OK - unknown ids are silently omitted, not an error

request.description: {{userId}} defaults to the seeded current-user.
Partial update -- send only the fields you want to change. Self only: {{userId}} must match the caller.

response.name: 409 Conflict - email already in use
403 Forbidden - not your own account

request.description: Blocked with 409 if the user has paid for or split any expense, or sent/received a payment. Self only: {{userId}} must match the caller.

response.name: 409 Conflict - user has expenses/group history
403 Forbidden - not your own account

item.name: Groups
item.description: Group CRUD. Rename and membership changes both go through the same PATCH. The caller is always added to memberIds on create even if they left themselves out, and List only returns groups the caller is a member of. Get/Update/Delete are guarded -- non-members get a 403.

request.description: memberIds must be non-empty, unique, and each reference an existing user.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - memberId does not reference a user

request.description: {{groupId}} defaults to the seeded group-daaru-party.

response.name: 403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

request.description: Partial update. `memberIds`, when sent, fully replaces the current membership -- it is not a delta/patch of individual adds or removes. Omitting a current member (including the caller leaving) is blocked with 409 while their balance in the group is unsettled.

response.name: 200 OK - replace membership (full array, not a delta)
400 Bad Request - memberId does not reference a user
409 Conflict - removed member has an unsettled balance
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

request.description: Cascades: deletes the group's memberships, expenses, expense splits, and payments too. Blocked with 409 while any member of the group has a non-zero balance.

response.name: 409 Conflict - group has unsettled balances
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

item.name: Invitations
item.description: Invite an email that is not yet registered to join a group. The raw token is never returned by the API -- it only goes out in the invite email (`${FRONTEND_URL}/register?invite=<token>`), so treat `{{inviteToken}}` below as something you copy from that link/log, not from a response body.

request.description: Only for emails that are not yet registered. If the email already belongs to a registered user, look them up via Users > Lookup and add them directly with Groups > Update instead.

response.name: 200 OK - a pending invitation for this email already exists (idempotent)
409 Conflict - email already belongs to a registered user
409 Conflict - email already an active member of this group
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

request.description: Public -- no token required to call this endpoint (the invitation token itself is the credential). The frontend calls this when the registration page loads with `?invite=` in the URL, to show which group/email the invite is for before the person registers.

response.name: 404 Not Found - token does not match any invitation
409 Conflict - expired, revoked, or already accepted

item.name: Expenses
item.description: Nested under a group. The server independently recomputes the expected split from amount + splitType and rejects the write (400) if it doesn't reconcile with what you submitted -- never trust splits blindly.

request.description: splitType is one of equal | exact | percentage | shares. equal recomputes from the participant userIds in `splits`; exact just validates `splits` sums to `amount`; percentage/shares require the matching `percentages`/`shares` array as additional input the server uses to recompute and validate `splits`. Largest-remainder rounding is used so cent-level splits always sum exactly to `amount`.

response.name: 400 Validation Error - missing required field
400 Bad Request - submitted splits do not reconcile (equal)
400 Bad Request - exact split does not sum to amount
400 Bad Request - percentages missing for percentage split
400 Bad Request - percentages do not sum to 100
400 Bad Request - shares missing for shares split
400 Bad Request - paidByUserId/split userId does not reference a user
404 Not Found - group does not exist
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group
404 Not Found - group does not exist
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

request.description: Scoped to the group in the URL -- an expense that exists but belongs to a different group also 404s here, rather than leaking cross-group data.

response.name: 404 Not Found - not found in this group
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

request.description: Full replacement, not a partial patch -- resend every field (description, amount, paidByUserId, splitType, splits, and percentages/shares if applicable), validated exactly like create. Same reconciliation rules apply.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - submitted splits do not reconcile
404 Not Found
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

request.description: Cascades to the expense's own splits.

response.name: 404 Not Found
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

item.name: Payments
item.description: A direct transfer between two group members that settles part of a debt. Immutable once created -- create and list-by-group only, no get-by-id/update/delete.

response.name: 400 Validation Error - missing required field
400 Bad Request - fromUserId/toUserId does not reference a user
404 Not Found - group does not exist
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group
404 Not Found - group does not exist
403 Forbidden - not a member of this group

item.name: Balances
item.description: Read-only, derived from every expense and payment in the group. Positive balance = owed money, negative = owes money.

request.description: `settlements` is the Simplify Debt-minimized transaction list -- the fewest payments needed to bring every member to zero, not a raw pairwise ledger. The 200 example here is real output from the seeded demo data.

response.name: 403 Forbidden - not a member of this group
